_about: Every map's named sectors (areas) with continent-coord polygons, for the addon's offline Zone Display popup. Keyed by mapId under `maps`: {name, regionName, continentId, mapRect [minX,minY,maxX,maxY], continentRect [left,top,right,bottom], sectors:[{id,name,coord,bounds}]}. Coords are raw continent coords (the addon transforms world->continent + point-in-polygons itself). `build` is the GW2 build id this was generated against (build_sectors.py --check skips the rebuild when the live build matches). Regenerate with builder/build_sectors.py.
